title: Admin Enrolments 群組檢視 — 分組列出 enroller + registrants，顯示總費用
content: Admin Enrolments 頁面目前每筆 registrant 各自獨立一列，ORGANIZATION 群組報名的 N 人會出現 N 列，管理員無法看出誰是付款者（enroller）、總費用多少。改為群組檢視：enroller 列（含總費用 + Approve/Reject）為主，其下展開 registrant 列（含各自憑證資料與個別費用）。

evidence.residual: 暫不處理 i18n（所有 admin 頁面皆為固定英文，待 AD-001 或專屬卡片處理）

comments: Per-person full fee model confirmed with user: each registrant pays the full course fee, enroller pays the sum. Server does NOT divide by headcount anymore.
acceptance: API returns grouped data: enroller's organization as parent row (from User table) with members[] children
Parent row shows organization name, NOT a person's name
Parent row shows total fee = sum of ALL members' individual fees (enroller has no fee)
Parent row registrant count = members.length (enroller NOT counted)
Parent row shows 'Enroller: <email>' below org name
Parent row ID doc is empty (enroller is not a registrant)
Member rows show credentials (name, ID doc, IA license, email) + individual fee
Member fee column is right-aligned, matching parent fee column
Member rows have no Approve/Reject buttons
Approve/Reject on parent row batch-updates all members via groupId
files: src/app/api/admin/enrolments/route.ts (rewrite — group by groupId, fetch enroller from User table, correct parent row)
src/app/[locale]/admin/enrolments/page.tsx (rewrite — org name as parent, empty ID doc, right-aligned fees)
dependencies: EN-016 (HKID 單一欄位) 已完成 — no blocker
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint 通過。
comments: V2 rework: enroller has NO registrant row. Parent uses User table for org name. All registrants are children. Fee = sum of all members' fees. Count = members.length.
Per-person full fee model confirmed with user: each registrant pays the full course fee, enroller pays the sum. Server does NOT divide by headcount anymore.
